This interactive app allows users to explore key variables and trends in 
hurricane intensity data. Featuring dynamic visualizations, it helps uncover 
relationships between storm characteristics, environmental factors, and 
forecasted intensity.

📌 **Key highlights:**

- Visualizing hurricane tracks and key predictors  
- Examining relationships between variables and storm intensity  
- Exploring spatial and temporal trends in the data  

The app is based on data from the [Hurricane Intensity Prediction](/projects/reports/hurricane-intensity/index.qmd) project.
